title: Sales and Marketing Manager
description:
**Sales & Marketing Manager - Pune, Maharashtra**

Company: Indo Vacuum Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
Location: Pune, Maharashtra  
Job type: Full-time  
Experience: 7–8 years  
Reports to: Senior Management, Head Office (Belgaum)

**About Indo Vacuum Technologies**

Indo Vacuum Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's leading manufacturers and exporters of vacuum pumps and vacuum systems. Our headquarters and manufacturing plant are in Belgaum, Karnataka, with branch offices in major cities across India. Our vision is to become a global leader in vacuum technology through continuous innovation and excellent service.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Sales & Marketing Manager to lead and grow our business in the Pune region. You will develop new customers across industrial sectors, manage key accounts, build a dealer and channel partner network, and help customers select the right vacuum pumps for their applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Development

* Generate leads and develop new customers through field visits, references and digital platforms
* Identify new business opportunities across industrial sectors in the region
* Manage existing and new customers, and build strong, long-term business relationships
* Achieve regional sales targets for vacuum pumps, systems, spare parts and consumables

Technical Sales and Application Support

* Understand the technical specifications and applications of our full range of vacuum pumps
* Support customers in selecting the right vacuum pump based on their application
* Coordinate with the technical and service teams at Head Office for product selection and customer support
* Prepare and negotiate techno-commercial offers through to order closure

Channel Development

* Develop dealer, distributor and channel partner networks based on regional requirements
* Train and support channel partners to grow sales in their territories

Marketing and Brand Building

* Promote products through exhibitions, industrial events and trade fairs
* Build brand awareness and improve market visibility in the region
* Promote vacuum pump spare parts and consumables to existing customers

Reporting and Coordination

* Follow up on qualified leads shared by the marketing team
* Ensure timely payment collection from customers
* Share regular sales reports, forecasts and market updates with senior management

**Requirements**

* DME / BE (Mechanical preferred)
* 7–8 years of experience in sales and marketing of industrial products such as pumps, valves or similar equipment
* Strong customer network across industrial sectors in the region
* Ability to understand technical specifications and discuss applications with customers
* Experience developing dealers, distributors or channel partners
* Proficient in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Good communication in English, Hindi and Marathi
* Willingness to travel extensively within the region

**Preferred**

* Experience selling vacuum pumps, compressors or fluid-handling equipment
* Existing relationships in pharma, chemical, food processing or engineering industries

**What We Offer**

* Product training at our Belgaum manufacturing plant

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
